blocks.text: HOARDING CLEANOUT FAQ
Frequently Asked Questions About Hoarding Cleanouts in East Gwillimbury

items.q: How much does a hoarding cleanout cost in East Gwillimbury?
a: Pricing is based on how many rooms are affected and how much sorting the belongings need — never on which community the property is in. The figure is confirmed free at a private walkthrough.

items.q: Do you actually charge the hamlets the same as the 404 corridor?
a: Always. Holland Landing, Sharon, Mount Albert and Queensville price exactly like a Green Lane subdivision for the identical job — same crew, same price, no exceptions.

items.q: Do you charge extra for farm properties on the concessions?
a: Never. The identical flat pricing applies at a hamlet home, a corridor subdivision, and a farm property between them.

items.q: What's the best way to clean out a hoarder's house?
a: Professional help, a clear plan, and patience. Going in without a strategy usually causes more distress than progress. The most effective approach sorts systematically — keep, donate, recycle, dispose — and moves at a pace the household can genuinely handle.

items.q: How do you handle a hoarding cleanout in a home that's been in a family for generations?
a: With real patience. The crew works at a pace that respects what the home represents to the family, not just how much sorting it requires.

items.q: Can the cleanout include a barn or outbuilding, not just the house?
a: Yes — it’s regular work for us on the township’s farm properties, all under one flat price.

items.q: What happens if we find valuables, documents or sentimental items?
a: They’re set aside immediately and brought to the family, never sorted into a donation or disposal pile by default.

items.q: What if the property has safety hazards — pests, mould, structural damage?
a: Those get flagged honestly. Live Junk Free doesn’t disturb suspected biohazards or structural issues — the concern is identified and the household is pointed toward the right licensed specialist before the rest of the cleanout proceeds.
